title: Full review: a training course report
summary: Bring together IF, COUNTIF, AVERAGE, SUMIF, COUNTIFS and VLOOKUP in one report.
intro:
In this full review you write a report on a training course using most of what you have learned: `IF`, `COUNTIF`, `AVERAGE`, `SUMIF`, `COUNTIFS`, and `VLOOKUP` with `IFERROR`.

Read each question carefully and choose the right function before you type: are you counting, adding or looking something up?

faq.q: How do I choose between `COUNTIF` and `COUNTIFS`?
faq.a: Use `COUNTIF` for one condition, and `COUNTIFS` when a row has to meet more than one condition.

faq.q: What if I forget the order of a function's arguments?
faq.a: Open the function's page in the function guide: it shows how to write the function, with worked examples.

review-if.prompt: These are the results of a training course. In `E2`, write the result "Pass" if Amal's test score is 60 or more, and "Fail" otherwise.

review-countif.prompt: In `G2`, write the number of trainees from Riyadh.

review-average-test.prompt: In `G3`, write the average test score.

review-sumif.prompt: In `G4`, write the total days attended by the trainees from Riyadh.

review-countifs.prompt: In `G5`, write how many trainees attended 7 days or more and scored 60 or more in the test.

review-lookup.prompt: In `G6`, write the score of the trainee whose name is in `F7`, or "Not found" if they are not on the list.
review-lookup.hint: The score is in the fourth column of `A2:D7`.

review-which-function.prompt: Which function fits the question "How many trainees from Cairo attended more than 5 days?"
